accessibility.evidence: Manual Previous/Next buttons update the live counter. Highlight and Editorial images open the existing modal viewer. Native links, existing Close focus and keyboard controls retained.

responsive.evidence: Highlights checked at 1440 and 390 pixels with no horizontal overflow. Side images have 2:3 proportions and centre 3:4. Editorial page at 390 also fits.

loading.evidence: Viewer displays Loading photograph before full-resolution image loads; image dimensions reserve gallery space.

empty.reason: Static curated collection has no search/query or user-created dataset; no empty query state.

error.evidence: Replaced viewer source with invalid image data; actual error message offered original link or another image.

partial.evidence: After image error, Next loaded a different image successfully without closing viewer.

success.evidence: Highlights Next changed counter to 2 of 6 and modal opened. Three category pages and all local source/navigation paths checked.

permission.reason: Images imported from the supplied publicly accessible Drive folders. Public static galleries require no account or runtime Drive access. Two website backup archives excluded.

renderedEvidence.observation: Large central portrait and two smaller side portraits with category navigation.
Triptych and category navigation fit mobile.
